Early, 6th of Month X The portal flung us into an area never marked on any map. It's quiet here, with few monsters. The scouts climbed to a vantage point and returned with intelligence: in the crimson forest to the northeast stands a ruined cathedral, with a great red tree growing atop it. This place isn't on any map — it appears to be our patrol's destination. I sent the scouts ahead to blaze a trail; the rest of us would rest here.

Afternoon, 6th of Month X They didn't come back. We waited the entire day. At dusk, the sentry said he'd go look for them. I told him to take one attendant — get in, get out, find them and return. I watched their silhouettes vanish into the fungal woods. For a split second, I wanted to call them back.

7th of Month X Yesterday's two didn't return either, so I took the remaining three and went. The cathedral was more dilapidated up close than from afar. Two sets of armor lay at the entrance — our people! There was another set I didn't recognize, likely from an earlier expedition. I lifted one of the visors — empty inside, nothing at all. We went on high alert, peering through the side windows — dead silence within. After confirming it was safe, we went in.

———————— Something was wrong with that tree. It seemed... alive. The sound started then — not through the ears... directly inside my head. Like many people whispering? The cleric fell first. He just stood there, and his body began to... melt? Another squad member rushed to pull him away, and he started melting too?! Something is terribly wrong, we must leave now! But my head was splitting, I couldn't move my legs... dimly, I seemed to see many figures flickering within the cathedral, they
didn't move, only watched me. I heard them calling my name.

Xth of Month X I don't know how long I was unconscious. When I awoke, I was alone — the others had all vanished. Where they had been, only a single scarlet flower remained. I don't know why I'm still alive. I wanted to approach the tree, to see what lay beneath it. But I couldn't get through. With every step, an inexplicable dread grew within me. There is something inside that tree — I can feel it. Deep within the trunk, beneath the earth... perhaps it is what the Church has been seeking.

But in the end I lacked the courage to cross over. It seemed to have rejected me; I could feel that I was not the one It sought. I want to leave, but the piglins outside the cathedral lurk in the depths of the forest, watching hungrily, yet seemingly too afraid to approach. So I camp near the entrance for the night, as far from that tree as possible. _______  _______  _______

Who am I?... Why am I here? I seem to have forgotten many things, but it doesn't feel important anymore. I can't quite understand the contents of this diary, but I can still write. ______  Someone else has come. I cannot let them near that tree. I must not let anyone reach that place. I must not let anyone hear those voices and then... end up like me.
